# Unused method formals with scalar results

Owned Java inputs preserve a public instance method whose unused Object-bounded
formal contributes no runtime binding. Its closed nominal context has a complete
binary generic ancestor and a marker interface. The original IOException
contract, scalar result and virtual dispatch remain observable.

Frozen callers and a future subclass compare 128 cases twice for source and SDK
declarations. They observe exact receivers and contexts, scalar values, callback
order and writes, early input casts, null dereferences, and checked/runtime/error
identity. Ten independent wrong programs qualify the observer. Eight Signature
controls preserve every original Code body and descriptor. Every recovered
source compiles; original class/method metadata and Exceptions are compared.
Only these owned fixtures and harnesses execute.
